The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Beginner Guide

In The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, beginners can prepare food and plan short routes before exploring.

In the game you can explore freely.

Check the cooking pot before leaving camp. Prepare food from available ingredients, and save a healing meal for a difficult climb. Keep enough stamina to return safely; follow short routes until the basic controls feel familiar.

Before exploring, prepare food for healing and save stamina for the return climb.
